name: retok (accounting cross-check)
summary: A local token-analytics tool with no dependencies, which the maintainer would run on the same transcripts to cross-check the engine's token accounting. Young (created 2026-07-06). Maintainer only; never installed for users. The engine's own accounting is the simpler alternative.

evidence.effect: Reads local session logs for tokens, cache hits and cost; no accuracy check found

killTest.hypothesis: An independent accounting cross-check is useful
killTest.pass: Totals match within 2% on 20 transcripts and it makes no network calls
killTest.scheduled: Not scheduled; maintainer only, within a 1-week time box

egress.default: none expected; K-RETOK checks that it makes no network calls

maintenance: Young third-party project, used by the maintainer only.
